item.title: NAJ invites jewellery businesses to explore new Job Seeker Directory
item.description: Retail Jeweller NAJ invites jewellery businesses to explore new Job Seeker Directory The National Association of Jewellers has launched its free Jewellery Job Seeker Directory, inviting businesses across the UK to connect with prospective talent from across the industry. NAJ invites jewellery businesses to explore new Job Seeker Directory Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Watches and Wonders Geneva reveals expanded 2026 programme
item.description: Retail Jeweller Watches and Wonders Geneva reveals expanded 2026 programme Watches and Wonders Geneva has unveiled details of its 2026 programme, with organisers promising an expanded edition featuring new exhibiting brands, citywide activations and a broad schedule of industry and public events. Watches and Wonders Geneva reveals expanded 2026 programme Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Bradley’s Jewellers York to showcase York Rose collection and one of a kind tiara at York Ice Trail
item.description: Retail Jeweller Bradley’s Jewellers York to showcase York Rose collection and one of a kind tiara at York Ice Trail Independent retailer Bradley’s Jewellers York is set to spotlight its York Rose collection and a unique diamond tiara during this year’s York Ice Trail, which takes place across the city centre on 7 and 8 February 2026. Bradley’s Jewellers York to showcase York Rose collection and one of a kind tiara at York Ice Trail Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Bishopsland Educational Trust appoints Tom Jones as chair of trustees
item.description: Retail Jeweller Bishopsland Educational Trust appoints Tom Jones as chair of trustees Bishopsland Educational Trust has appointed Tom Jones as its new chair of trustees, succeeding Howard Dellar who stepped down at the organisation’s annual general meeting on 4 February 2026 after eight years in the role. item.title: Store Design: Maya Magal, Coal Drops Yard, London
item.description: Retail Jeweller Store Design: Maya Magal, Coal Drops Yard, London A stylish shopping spot with an industrial past, Coal Drops Yard in King’s Cross, London, is the ideal home for British jewellery brand Maya Magal. May Garland takes a look around the store. Store Design: Maya Magal, Coal Drops Yard, London May Garland

item.title: Goldsmiths’ Centre appoints Julia Balchin as interim director
item.description: Retail Jeweller Goldsmiths’ Centre appoints Julia Balchin as interim director The Goldsmiths’ Centre has announced the appointment of Julia Balchin as interim director, with the former Royal Drawing School principal set to take up the position in March 2026, succeeding outgoing director Peter Taylor MBE. Goldsmiths’ Centre appoints Julia Balchin as interim director Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Breitling named Official Watch Partner of Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team
item.description: Retail Jeweller Breitling named Official Watch Partner of Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team Swiss watch brand Breitling has announced a new global multi year partnership with Aston Martin and the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team, becoming the team’s Official Watch Partner and marking the watch brand’s return to Formula 1. Breitling named Official Watch Partner of Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Three charged over Knightsbridge armed robbery
item.description: Retail Jeweller Three charged over Knightsbridge armed robbery Three men have been charged in connection with an armed robbery at a luxury store in Knightsbridge last month, during which high-value watches were reportedly stolen. Three charged over Knightsbridge armed robbery Ruth Faulkner

item.title: ROX launches permanent jewellery concession at Fairmont St Andrews
item.description: Retail Jeweller ROX launches permanent jewellery concession at Fairmont St Andrews Jeweller ROX has announced the launch of a new jewellery concession at Fairmont St Andrews, marking an expansion of its luxury retail presence through a partnership with the five-star Scottish resort. ROX launches permanent jewellery concession at Fairmont St Andrews Ruth Faulkner

item.title: KOUREE collaborates with Sharmadean Reid on limited-edition ‘Life Lessons’ charm
item.description: Retail Jeweller KOUREE collaborates with Sharmadean Reid on limited-edition ‘Life Lessons’ charm Demi-fine jewellery brand KOUREE has partnered with entrepreneur and creative Sharmadean Reid on a new limited-edition charm designed to symbolise resilience, personal growth and transformation.
